name: Poison & Ivy
source:
Ivy is a shy, insecure young woman who really wishes she had a boyfriend. A talking bee tells her that she can summon one. He ends up being a demon, but Ivy doesn't mind. Tho, he will disappear once Ivy has a "one-night stand" with him. However, Ivy thinks she can charm him enough to stay.

[From [url=https://nickrowler.itch.io/poison-ivy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
艾薇是一位害羞、缺乏安全感的年轻女性，她真的希望自己有一个男朋友。一只会说话的蜜蜂告诉她她可以召唤一只蜜蜂。他最终成为了恶魔，但艾薇并不介意。不过，一旦艾薇和他发生了“一夜情”，他就会消失。然而，艾薇认为她足以吸引他留下来。

[来自[url=https://nickrowler.itch.io/poison-ivy]itch.io[/url]]
